LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.exists_blockSourc: For an iid source with finite alphabet and law p, every rate R > H(p) admits block codes with at least one message at each length, error tending to zero, and rate at most R at all sufficiently large lengths.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.tendsto_errorProb: For an iid source with finite alphabet and law p, fix R < H(p). Every sequence of block codes with positive message budgets whose rates are eventually at most R has error probability tending to one.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.eventually_entrop: For a finite-alphabet iid source with law p, any sequence of codes with positive message budgets and error tending to zero eventually has rate at least H(p) − δ, for each δ > 0.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.sourceCoding_thre: The entropy H(p) of a finite-alphabet iid source is the infimum of the rates R for which block codes with positive message budgets have vanishing error and, for every η > 0, rate at most R + η at all sufficiently large lengths.
